## Scope

Stage/issue and implemented capability. State exclusions; do not imply full RORB compatibility.

## Evidence

- Revision, OS, Python and dependency versions:
- Ruff / Pyright / focused tests / relevant regressions:
- Source and installed-wheel checks:
- Native engine profile/hash and fixture IDs, where relevant:
- Passed / failed / not run / skipped, with reasons:
- Numerical tolerances and any changed expected results:
- Performance measurements, only when actually recorded:

## Safety and handoff

Confirm unchanged original inputs, no reference binaries/client data, no hosted workflow or publication, and an updated work record. Identify the next action and unresolved GUI/CMD differences. Do not use a stage-closing keyword until its acceptance gate is satisfied.
